verdict.rationale: YYLO ships an extensively documented CLI (`yy init`, `yy ledger`, `yy pi`, `yy loop`, workflow/benchmark commands) that lets an AI-native user drive the product programmatically, which functions as its public interface. However, explicit probes found no REST/OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt AI-friendly docs endpoint, so there is no formal machine-readable public API beyond the CLI surface. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/REST API spec, llms.txt or other AI-consumption doc format, independent corroboration of API stability/versioning.
